info.name: NexusMarket API - Complete Collection
info.description: Complete end-to-end Postman Collection for NexusMarket API (Hexagonal Architecture + DDD in Spring Boot 4.1.0). Covers all 10 controllers and 29 endpoints across Auth, Users, Sellers, Warehouses, Products & Catalog, Inventory, Buyers, Cart, Orders, and Audit, with automatic JWT variable chaining and pm.test assertions.

item.name: 01. Auth (/api/auth)

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
if (json && json.data && json.data.token) { pm.environment.set("adminToken", json.data.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("adminToken", json.data.token); }
pm.test("JWT token returned", function () { pm.expect(json.data.token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });
pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
if (json && json.data && json.data.token) { pm.environment.set("sellerToken", json.data.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("sellerToken", json.data.token); }
pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
if (json && json.data && json.data.token) { pm.environment.set("operatorToken", json.data.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("operatorToken", json.data.token); }
pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
if (json && json.data && json.data.token) { pm.environment.set("supervisorToken", json.data.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("supervisorToken", json.data.token); }
pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var json = pm.response.json();
if (json && json.data && json.data.token) { pm.environment.set("buyerToken", json.data.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("buyerToken", json.data.token); }
pm.test("Status code is 401 Unauthorized", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.description: Authentication endpoints (/api/auth). Run 1.1 first after starting the app to obtain adminToken, and run 1.2-1.5 after registering/onboarding the respective users.
